key_insight: Coherent finite-resolution prices or predictions provide a constructive foundation for stochastic processes, connecting Bayesian inference and asset pricing through controlled lattice-to-continuum limits.
engineering_relevance: The framework connects financial valuation and machine-learning prediction through adjoint recursions while providing quantitative convergence guarantees for stochastic computations.
method: Start with coherent previsions on finite lattices to construct conditional expectations.
Refine lattices toward the continuum, explicitly tracking renormalisation and convergence estimates.
Compute measure changes using Farkas’ lemma and connect pricing and prediction through adjoint recursions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports sharp convergence rates, 67 Python scripts regenerating every numerical table, and Lean 4 verification of much of the finite-dimensional core.
watch_item: Continuum measure-change guarantees depend on regularity and well-behaved reweighting; the abstract does not establish scalability for large machine-learning systems.
paper_title: Constructive Probability, Foundations and Numerical Analysis for mathematical finance and machine learning
